data.exact_reserve_text: Net claims incurred includes prior accident year reserve release totaling GBP 1.6m (2014: GBP 4.1m release).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding for 2015 was GBP 155.728m. The gross prior year development for 2015 was a strengthening of GBP 2.422m, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This overall strengthening was a result of mixed development, with releases for the 2011 and 2012 underwriting years and a strengthening for the 2013 underwriting year. The report also noted a 'relatively benign catastrophe environment during 2015', which likely contributed to some favorable development. The narrative text, however, reported a net prior year reserve release of GBP 1.6m, which differs from the gross movement.
raw_causal_phrases: the technical result benefitted from the relatively benign catastrophe environment during 2015.
Prior year reserve movements resulted in a GBP 1.6m release in 2015

The level of provision has been set on the basis of the information that is currently available, including potential outstanding loss advices, experience of development of similar claims, historical experience, case law and legislative and judicial actions.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development amount of +2.422m (strengthening) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle on page 14. This contrasts with the narrative on page 3 and Note 7 (page 19) which states a 'net claims incurred includes prior accident year reserve release totaling GBP 1.6m'. The gross triangle figure is used as per instructions to prioritize gross figures.
